packageRules.description: Pi is the host this package extends, and users run whatever pi released last. Build against that release the day it ships instead of waiting out the release-age gate, and raise the devDependency floor to it rather than only moving the lockfile. The peer ranges stay "*"; bump leaves wildcards alone.

Pinned to the version pi ships. Pi's extension loader aliases typebox to its own bundled copy, so our declaration only types what pi executes and must match it. It moves when pi moves, not on Renovate's schedule; the typebox pin test reports when that happens.
The renovate tasks in mise.toml run Renovate on the Node its engines field names, which is older than the project's. They are the only tools.node still on 24; move them when Renovate's engines move.

@types/node describes the runtime, so it tracks the Node these packages run on rather than the newest DefinitelyTyped release. Types from a later major describe APIs that are not there and hide ones that were removed, and tsc believes them either way. It follows the engines floor in package.json, not the toolchain in mise.toml, which may run newer; raise the ceiling when the floor moves.
